scope: Independent SANDBOX position research sidecar; not an execution strategy rollout
timer_schedule: Every five minutes, offset minute 02, second 10, Asia/Shanghai; up to 15 seconds jitter

coverage: On-chain provider, pure evidence, PostgreSQL store and task runner
Real adapter to evidence to runner to isolated PostgreSQL contracts
Existing positioning provider/evidence/store/entry/contracts and trend campaign regression
Timeout, response bounds, 429, durable cooldown, stale success and failed persistence
Unknown identities, stale data, zero positions and unmapped-symbol fair rotation
Least-privilege role, immutable first receipt, idempotency and bounded retention
Real Q/AKE Uniswap v4 bytes32 pool identifiers without weakening token address validation
validation.test_scope_note: This is the complete related research regression set, not every test in the entire trading repository.

live_smoke.pools: Three reported pools per symbol; PARTIAL coverage, freshness UNVERIFIED
live_smoke.uniswap_v4: Both symbols' bytes32 pool IDs persisted; pool_address=null, identity_kind=BYTES32_POOL_ID
live_smoke.prior_smoke: The previous slot's immutable records retain UNKNOWN pool evidence from the discovered v4 compatibility defect. The fix was validated in a new slot; historical evidence was not rewritten.

isolation.resource_note: Shared CPU, storage and PostgreSQL overhead is bounded, not literally zero; external research failures do not become execution dependencies.

downgrade.provider_failure: Stop this research batch; persist provider-only backoff; do not retry immediately or block trading
downgrade.local_storage_failure: Do not start, or stop further, external requests; sanitize journal error
downgrade.unknown_or_expired_asset: UNKNOWN; no ticker guessing and no implied permission or rejection of a trade

limits: Initial reviewed mappings cover only Q and AKE on BSC, not every contract or chain.
Buy/sell USD values are provider aggregates, not wallet net flows or all Binance trading.
Individual swaps, LP changes, exchange wallet ownership/flows, block finality and reorg evidence remain UNKNOWN.
PARTIAL is the expected evidence label, not a hidden complete-data or profitability claim.
No order, position-size, stop, leverage, risk policy or production-environment intervention was enabled.
Trading usefulness still requires forward samples and matched comparisons; this deployment proves collection and isolation, not alpha.
rollback: Disable and stop only trade-v2-onchain-research.timer and trade-v2-onchain-research.service. Preserve research tables and immutable releases for audit; no main service restart or data reset is required.
